annotations.title: Find roles that grant a permission

description: Reverse lookup: which roles grant a permission, least-privileged first. For Azure, pass an operation such as "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listKeys/action" (wildcards and notActions are applied) or a pattern such as "Microsoft.KeyVault/*". For Microsoft 365, pass keywords such as "reset password"; they are matched against RBAC Map's plain-language permission descriptions.

permission.description: Azure operation or pattern, or Microsoft 365 keywords.

service.description: Limit to one service, e.g. "entra" or "azure".

name: find_roles_with_permission
